summary: Backend regression testing for Liniar manufaktur fashion app. Verified auth (login sets httpOnly cookie, protected endpoints return 401), purchases (total = qty * unit_cost), production (HPP = total_cost/output_qty), inventory listing, ready-to-sell (ready_qty + sell_status fields), sales for all 5 valid channels (Offline, Bazar, Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok) with proper revenue/cogs/gross_profit calculation and stock decrement, rejection of legacy 'Marketplace' channel (422), stock over-availability check (409), and dynamic reports endpoint with channel filter + channel_summary. All 13 tests passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes operating_expense=3840000 and liabilities=21800000 (magic numbers) — should come from DB or config.

Legacy 'Marketplace' sales_transactions remain in DB and still contribute to income.revenue on channel=Semua, but are not shown in channel_summary. Consider a data migration to reassign or exclude legacy rows so revenue == sum(channel_summary revenue) for consistency.
seed_data() has no seeded sales_transactions — /reports on a fresh DB would return zeros; acceptable but note for onboarding.
POST /sales uses unit_cost = value/stock which becomes stale as stock decrements; consider snapshotting cost per SKU or using weighted-average COGS to avoid drift.
CORS: allow_origins falls back to '*' when neither FRONTEND_URL nor CORS_ORIGINS is set — combined with allow_credentials=True this is invalid per spec; ensure env is always set in prod.
seed_data_creation: None; used seeded inventory items (LIN-OVR-001 has available=36, sufficient for 5-channel test). Test-created sales/purchases/production rows use TEST_ prefixes or synthetic SKUs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is idempotent across runs as long as inventory item LIN-OVR-001 has >=5 available. All 13 backend tests currently pass. Frontend was NOT tested (backend-only scope). Legacy 'Marketplace' rows exist in sales_transactions from prior sessions and inflate reports.income.revenue on channel=Semua vs channel_summary sum — this is expected per problem statement.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the requested scope.
